<!-- pr-reviewer: 3460d7ba831c7f690f5d88dce96a31774e0f1674 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Results merged with main (be27a4c7) on the self-hosted runner, run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43530581030 : success. Quick gate ok (post suites 32s, app suites 133s, 0 failed); clippy on camcraft-app and camcraft-post with -D warnings clean. Windows-only readings: none changed.

Delta since our review of 72e0b8b6e is NEW CODE by `merge-plan --delta` (two commits), read in full:

**Earlier request, fixed**
- Item 1 (stale "every shipped post sets it" text): e188b4f6 changes `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` to "except grblhal.cps and tinyg.cps, which still take the word (offsets 1-6 only; follow-up issue)". The P7 follow-up is #1385. Docs only; no code in that commit.

**Merge 3460d7ba (main refresh), read with `--remerge-diff`**
- Four conflicts, all both-sides-kept: `fanuc-lathe.cps` (workOffsetIndex/Max beside main's explainWords/explainTool), `mazak.cps` (`wcsIndex` beside main's reworded `sRpm`), `engine.rs` (`work_offset::Manifest::read` followed by main's `explain::form`), `post/mod.rs` (`rotary_cap` and `work_offset`).
- `engine.rs:119-123`: both reads run on the loaded script, neither depends on the other; the translate call at `engine.rs:164` is unchanged.
- Work offset law: the app still hands the setup's word via `setup::wcs_slot`; the only number-to-word step is `work_offset::Manifest::translate`. No second derivation, no path where the posted offset differs from the setup's. Out-of-range, non-index and unflagged-above-6 values are still refused by setup name (warning, which the app turns into "post blocked").
- No Cargo, build.rs, .github, scripts, .cargo, toolchain or xtask file in the PR. No golden or snapshot PNG changed beyond the earlier `PARAM WorkOffset` stream lines.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. New on main since the earlier head: `sinker-iso.cps`, `sodick-wire.cps` and `wire-iso.cps` read `WorkOffset` without `workOffsetIndex`. They take the legacy path (1-6 post G54-G59 as before, higher is refused), so safe, but `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` now names only grblhal and tinyg as the exceptions. Please widen that sentence (and #1385) to the three wire/EDM posts.
2. The PathPilot Hub run (G59.1-G59.3, 2026-11-13) is recorded on the PR; the author states the diff against base is unchanged line for line, so it stands.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
